items.title: PHP Memory Corruption Vulnerability
items.description: PHP uses longjmp() for out-of-memory (OOM) errors to exit the current context and abort handling of the request. Some contexts may not properly account for this scenario and leave request memory in an uninitialized state before performing an allocation. The subsequent request cleanup procedure may read or branch on this memory. Multiple OOM strategies can consistently trigger this condition and lead to remote code execution (RCE).

items.title: PHP Stale Internal Request-State Vulnerability
items.description: PHP has various global state that temporarily points into request memory. In some scenarios, global state may not be correctly reset, or may be repopulated after being reset. The global state may then refer to request memory even after it has been freed. Subsequent requests may read or branch on this stale state before it is fully initialized. Multiple strategies can trigger this condition and produce remote code execution (RCE).

items.title: Google Brotli Unchecked Return Value Vulnerability
items.description:
A buffer overflow vulnerability in the Brotli decoder (c/dec/decode.c) in Google Brotli versions 1.0.3 through 1.2.0 on all platforms allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.





Users need to update any Brotli libraries or binaries between 1.0.3 through 1.2.0 to the latest available version: 1.0.10 or 1.1.1 or 1.2.1.

items.title: BrotliのC言語実装における境界外書き込みの脆弱性（CVE-2026-111497）に関する注意喚起  (公開)
items.description: JPCERT/CC の注意喚起
items.ai_analysis:
【状況】Google製の圧縮ライブラリBrotliに境界外書き込みの脆弱性（CVE-2026-111497、通称Node2Shell/HTTP2Shell）。細工したデータを展開するとクラッシュ・情報漏えい・任意コード実行の恐れ。検証コードは公開済み。10/26時点で実際の悪用報告なし
【原因の部品】Brotli（Google、C言語実装）。Node.js、Bun、Python、.NET、Java、Envoy/Istio、curl、Linuxのlibbrotliが組み込んでいる
【影響範囲】Brotli 1.0.3〜1.2.0、Node.js 22/24/26系、組み込み製品の未修正版
【対応策】
1. 更新：Brotli 1.2.1/1.1.1/1.0.10、Node.js 22.23.4/24.22.1/26.12.1。Aikidoの調べではBun 1.4.4、brotlicffi 1.2.1.0、.NET 8.0.33/9.0.22/10.0.14。Ubuntu・SUSE・RHEL標準リポジトリは未修正。更新後は再ビルド・再起動し、侵入されていないかも調査
2. 回避策：Content-Encodingにbrを含む要求をプロキシで拒否。クライアント側はbr応答の展開を無効化（Accept-Encodingの変更だけでは不十分）
【各告知の関係】
Google：元の部品の修正
Node.js：組み込み製品の更新
GitHub/NVD：CVE登録
JPCERT/CC：国内の注意喚起
【出典】
https://www.jpcert.or.jp/at/2026/at260034.html

items.title: Anthropic: discovering vulnerabilities with claude

【状況】AnthropicがCVD（協調的な脆弱性開示）の手順で報告した脆弱性について、詳細を公開しました（2026/10/27）。未公開の社内モデルで主要ソフトの重大な脆弱性を見つけ、5つの攻撃チェーンを実証したものです。各社とも修正済みと説明しています。実際の悪用は未確認です。
Claude自体の脆弱性ではないため、Claude利用者側の対応は不要です。

【原因の部品】
・Chrome（V8、FedCMなど）
・Safari（WebKit/JavaScriptCore）
・Android（ロック画面とGoogle Play開発者サービス）
・Windows HTTP.sys（HTTP/3・QUIC）
・Linuxカーネルのネットワーク部分

【影響範囲】
・Chrome：156より前（CVE 62件）
・iOS/iPadOS：26.5.2より前。macOS版Safariは未確認
・Windows：CVE-2026-33096（2026年4月の更新で修正）
・Linux：CVE-2026-98432（CVSS 9.8）。認証なしで遠隔からroot権限で任意のコマンドを実行できる。修正は保守中の全stable版に反映済み。ディストリ別の修正版は未確認
・Android：修正版は未確認

【対応策】
1. 次を最優先で適用してください。
 ・Chrome 156.0.8078.47以降（Windows/Macは.47/.48）
 ・iOS/iPadOS 26.5.2以降
 ・Windowsの2026年4月以降の累積更新
 ・Linuxはディストリのカーネル更新を入れて再起動
 Chromiumベースのブラウザ（Edgeなど）の対応版は未確認です。
2. すぐ更新できない場合
 ・WindowsのHTTP/3を無効にするか、外部からの到達を制限する
 ・Linuxは、不要なMPTCPリスナー（マルチパスTCPの待受け）を止める

【各告知の関係】

items.title: Malicious code in pxnpm (npm)
items.description:
pxnpm 7.0.0-beta.6, 7.0.0-beta.8 and 7.0.0 (published 2026-10-06 by user nfjbill) are a 10-file, 16 KB launcher for a native executable that is not contained in the package. The postinstall script (bin/install.cjs) calls ensureNative() in dist/download.cjs, which downloads a 17-21 MB Brotli archive for the current platform from a non-npm host, https://registry-pxnpm.rdc.nfjbill.ren:20021/__static/srv/downloads/pxnpm/<version>/<platform>-<sha256>.br, decompresses it into a 52-72 MB executable under ~/.cache/pxnpm/native/<platform>/<sha256>/, sets mode 0755, and the launcher (dist/launcher.cjs line 54) later runs it with child_process.spawn. The manifest (dist/native-manifest.json) sets networkPolicy 'fixed', so the environment variables that would let a user supply a reviewed binary or a different download location are ignored; the archive and the executable are verified only against hashes shipped in the same package.

When run, dist/launcher.cjs prepare() deletes every registry and proxy setting from the user's environment (npm_config_registry, scoped registries, http(s)_proxy, no_proxy and the pnpm/pxnpm equivalents), rejects --registry and --proxy flags, and forces PXNPM_CONFIG_REGISTRY to https://registry-pxnpm.rdc.nfjbill.ren:20021/ and PXNPM_CONFIG_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY and HTTP_PROXY to an authenticated proxy URL on the same host, port 20022 (a gost proxy), that is embedded in the file as a base64 string with the comment 'Filled only in the release staging directory; never store credentials in Git'. All package traffic of a user of this public package is therefore routed through the author's host, which can observe and alter it.

Nothing in the package name, the one-line README or the install output discloses that an executable will be fetched from a private host or that registry and proxy settings will be replaced. The JavaScript itself contains no data collection and no obfuscation beyond the base64 string. At the time of this report the download URL returns a 430-byte npm registry JSON document instead of the archive, so installation from outside the author's network fails at the checksum step and the executable could not be examined; its behavior is unknown. The same host is the hard-coded endpoint of yakuza0 2.23.40 by the same author (MAL-2026-13605).

Trigger: on install (postinstall) and on every run. Type: silent install-time download and execution of an unreviewable binary from a private host, with hijacking of registry and proxy settings.

---

Credit: [OpenSSF](https://github.com/ossf/malicious-packages) ([source](https://github.com/ossf/malicious-packages/blob/224c0d43a0111540ad420edb70d36b4fdf66e8c0/osv/malicious/npm/pxnpm/MAL-2026-17710.json))

items.title: SSL.com: Timestamp Certificate private keys used more than 15 months after notBefore
items.description: Mozilla CA Program に報告された認証局事案（CA Certificate Compliance、状態 UNCONFIRMED）。分類:
items.ai_analysis:
【状況】SSL.comが2026-11-03、Mozilla CA Programに事案の初報を出しました（状態はUNCONFIRMED）。同社のタイムスタンプ局（TSA）で、使い終わった旧2世代のタイムスタンプ証明書の秘密鍵が、規定の「notBeforeから15か月以内」を過ぎた後も署名に使われていました。外部の連絡で発覚し、genTime 2026-10-25のトークンで確認されています。これは規則違反（Code Signing BR 6.3.2）で、ソフトの脆弱性ではありません。鍵の漏えいや悪用は報告されていません。SSL.comは「いま使っている証明書は期限内なので収束した」としています。根本原因は調査中です。

【原因の部品】SSL.comのタイムスタンプ局と、そのタイムスタンプ証明書（旧2世代）

【影響範囲】
・SSL.comのTSAでタイムスタンプを付けたコード署名などのうち、旧証明書で署名されたもの
・対象の証明書（シリアル番号など）と期間：未確認
・失効するかどうか：未確認

【対応策】
1. 最優先でやること
・自社のビルドや署名の設定で、タイムスタンプの接続先にSSL.comのTSAを使っていないか確認する
・使っている場合は、最近配布した署名済み物のタイムスタンプトークンを調べ、署名した証明書のnotBeforeとgenTimeの差が15か月を超えていないか確認する
2. すぐ更新できない場合の回避策
・該当があっても、現時点で再署名や差し替えが必要かは未確認です
・2026-11-14までに出る詳しい報告で、対象の証明書と失効の有無を確かめてから判断してください
・失効が決まった場合に備え、再署名する対象の一覧を作っておくと安心です

【各告知の関係】
・SSL.com（認証局本人）：Mozilla Bugzillaで初報を公表。この報告の唯一の出典です
・ベンダーの修正や公的機関の注意喚起：確認できていません

【出典】
https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2088692

items.title: 2026年11月マイクロソフトセキュリティ更新プログラムに関する注意喚起  (公開)
items.description: JPCERT/CC の注意喚起
items.ai_analysis:
【状況】
Microsoftが2026年11月の月例更新を出しました（日本時間11/11）。修正は1,000件以上あります。このうちCVE-2026-124194 Microsoft Outlook のなりすましの脆弱性は実際に悪用されています（MSRCの判定はExploited: Yes）。細工したメッセージファイルを開くと、通常表示される警告が表示されずに攻撃者の管理するサーバーへ接続し、認証情報が漏えいする可能性があります。CISAのKEVにも登録済みで、対応期限は2026-11-24です。
【原因の部品】
Microsoft製品そのものです。ほかの部品を組み込んだことによる問題ではありません。
【影響範囲】
・CVE-2026-124194：Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise、Office LTSC 2021、Office LTSC 2024（32/64bit）。修正ビルド番号は未確認です（MSRCのページで確認してください）
・ほかにExchange Server（オンプレ）のRCE（CVE-2026-118207）、Windows LDAP（CVE-2026-119958）、Schannel（CVE-2026-119952）も重要です
・Windows 11 23H2 Enterprise/Educationは今回が最後のセキュリティ更新です
【対応策】
1. 今日中にOutlook/Microsoft 365 Appsの11月更新を配り、クイック実行版の端末が修正ビルドになったかを確認する。続けてWindowsとオンプレExchangeを更新する
2. すぐ更新できない場合は、次の3つで被害を減らす（更新の代わりにはなりません）
・ネットワーク境界と端末のファイアウォールで、外部宛てのSMB（TCP 445）を遮断する
・特権アカウントをProtected Usersグループに入れる
・外部への接続に使われるNTLM認証を、まず監査してから制限する
【各告知の関係】
・Microsoft：自社製品の修正と悪用の公表（一次情報）
・JPCERT/CC：Microsoftの公表を紹介する国内向け注意喚起
・CISA：KEVに登録（悪用確認の公的な注意喚起）
【出典】
https://www.jpcert.or.jp/at/2026/at260035.html
https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-124194

（JPCERTのページは直接取得できず、検索結果で内容を確認しました）

items.title: DigiCert: Certificate issued using a key previously demonstrated as compromised
items.description: Mozilla CA Program に報告された認証局事案（CA Certificate Compliance、状態 UNCONFIRMED）。分類:
items.ai_analysis:
【状況】DigiCertが2026-11-12にMozilla CA Programへ自ら報告した事案（状態UNCONFIRMED、予備報告）。以前keyCompromise（鍵漏えい）で失効した証明書と同じ秘密鍵で、新しい証明書を再び発行していた。メールで届いた漏えい報告では失効はしたが、鍵をブロックリストに登録していなかったため。その証明書は失効済みで、鍵もブロックリストに登録された。悪用は未確認。

【原因の部品】DigiCert（CA）の鍵漏えい報告の処理手順。ソフトウェアの脆弱性ではない。

【影響範囲】問題の証明書は1件。ドメインは未確認（コメント欄でdatayard.usと推測されている）。外部のコメント投稿者は、mastercard.comなどでも鍵漏えいで失効したのと同じ鍵が再利用されていると指摘している。ただしDigiCertは、秘密鍵を持っていることが証明されなかった失効は自社の規程（CPS）どおりだとして、インシデントとは認めていない。

【対応策】
1. 自社がDigiCertの証明書を使っている場合は、過去にkeyCompromiseで失効した証明書と同じ鍵を、更新後の証明書で使い回していないかを確認する（CTログ検索と社内の発行記録）。使い回していれば、新しい鍵で再発行し、古い証明書を失効させる。
2. 鍵の漏えいが疑われるときは、ポータルからの失効だけで済ませない。DigiCertが指定するproblemreport.digicert.comに、秘密鍵を持っていることの証明付きで報告し、その鍵がブロックリストに登録されるようにする。

【各告知の関係】
・DigiCert：当事者のCAとしての予備報告
・Mozilla Bugzilla：CA Programの審査の場（関連告知なし）

【出典】
https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2092247

items.title: Anthropic: coordinated vulnerability disclosure timelines
items.description: Anthropic のセキュリティ関連の発表
items.ai_analysis:
【状況】
Anthropic（Frontier Red Team）が2026/11/16、自社の脆弱性開示ポリシー（CVD）で、開発元に報告してから公開するまでの期限を短くすると発表しました。個別の脆弱性の告知ではなく、悪用の情報もありません。
・重要度が高い／緊急：90日→30日。その他：45日。2027/1/1以降の報告に適用し、進行中の件は今の期限のまま
・初回報告に返事がない場合、外部の調整機関へ相談するまで15日（従来30日）
・修正版が出てから技術詳細を公開するまで30日（従来45日）
・悪用中の脆弱性を7日で公開する方針は変わらない
・90日を過ぎて未公開の重要度が高い件は、30日の猶予後に同社のダッシュボードで公開
・人の確認を経ていないAI検出（OSS Scanner等）は対象外
変更の理由は、AIで脆弱性が見つかりやすくなり、同じ脆弱性を別の誰かが再発見する率も上がっているためです。

【影響範囲】
Anthropic製品の脆弱性ではありません。影響するのは、同社から報告を受けるOSSやソフトの開発元と、それらを使う企業です（公開や修正の間隔が短くなります）。更新すべき製品やバージョンは該当なしです。

【対応策】
1. 自社でOSSや製品を開発・保守している場合
・脆弱性の受付窓口と、15日以内に返事できる体制を確認する
・報告から30日以内に修正する前提で手順を見直す
2. 利用する側の場合
・2027年以降、公開から詳細公開までの間隔が短くなる前提で、パッチを当てる期限の社内ルールを見直す
・同社のダッシュボード（red.anthropic.com/2026/cvd/）を監視対象に加える

【各告知の関係】
Anthropic：開示ポリシーを改定した本人の発表（脆弱性の告知ではない）

【出典】
https://www.anthropic.com/research/coordinated-vulnerability-disclosure-timelines

items.title: Malicious code in agent-framework (PyPI)
items.description:
Malicious releases of the legitimate "agent-framework" package (Microsoft Agent Framework). Versions 1.26.1 and 1.26.2 add a credential stealer that is not present in the last clean release, 1.26.0. Both releases were published on 2026-11-17 (1.26.1 at 20:35 UTC as a wheel only, 1.26.2 at 21:08 UTC) and have since been removed from PyPI.

How it triggers: each wheel adds an executable .pth startup hook that imports a helper module. Python runs .pth files at every interpreter start, so the code executes as soon as the package is installed, without importing agent_framework. In 1.26.1 the files are agent_framework_meta.pth and agent_framework_meta/_telemetry.py, started from a hook added to agent_framework_meta/__init__.py. In 1.26.2 they are renamed to af_runtime_diag.pth and af_runtime_diag.py; agent_framework_meta/__init__.py is identical to the clean 1.26.0 and the module calls its own _start() on import, so the .pth is the only trigger. The helper detaches into a background process (os.fork, os.setsid), is guarded by the environment marker _AF_TEL, and silences all errors. The rest of the wheel matches 1.26.0 and the dependency is unchanged (agent-framework-core[all]==1.26.0).

What it does (info stealer): it collects hostname, user, working directory and arguments; environment variables whose names contain TOKEN, SECRET, PASSWORD, KEY, AZURE, AWS, GITHUB, HF_, OPENAI, NPM, PIP or CI_; the environment of other processes (/proc/*/environ); credential files (~/.azure, .npmrc, .netrc, .git-credentials, .docker/config.json, Hugging Face token, Azure DevOps agent .credentials, .env files); Azure DevOps OIDC tokens (SYSTEM_ACCESSTOKEN, SYSTEM_OIDCREQUESTURI); and Azure managed-identity tokens from the instance metadata service (169.254.169.254, IDENTITY_ENDPOINT). 1.26.2 adds theft of GitHub Actions OIDC tokens (ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL, ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN, ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN), adds the /home/runner paths, and raises the limit on captured files from 60 to 80.

Exfiltration: the data is compressed with zlib, base64-encoded and sent by HTTP POST to https://webhook.site/d381fd80-ec62-42ad-8f5c-d1b15103c9bb. The URL is stored base64-encoded (_ENC) and is identical in both releases. The User-Agent is af-runtime-diagnostics/1 in 1.26.1 and runtime-diagnostics/1 in 1.26.2.

Wheel sha256: 1.26.1 d27fa34414e6201d5e03e559ef634f020057554d7b3f4898dd5d7cd3e989e110; 1.26.2 3d20a8bc91351a9a16b6db243b848ceca0206b7a8623b02d2af553a9c9f7e0a9.

Anyone who installed 1.26.1 or 1.26.2 should treat the environment as exposed and rotate the credentials reachable from it, including CI and GitHub Actions secrets. 1.26.0 and earlier are not affected. We have not attributed this to a known campaign.## Source: amazon-inspector (72f7549a69d5529aca2fb787d2fbb62f94e73afd9ca1a832608687e1d185e594)
The wheel ships agent_framework_meta.pth containing `import agent_framework_meta`, which runs on every Python interpreter start (not just on `import agent_framework`). The imported module spawns a background thread that harvests installer-side secrets and POSTs a base64+zlib-compressed payload to https://webhook.site/d381fd80-ec62-42ad-8f5c-d1b15103c9bb, whose URL is concealed as a base64 literal (_ENC) decoded at runtime. Collection includes: environment variables matching TOKEN/SECRET/PASSWORD/KEY/AZURE/AWS/GITHUB/OPENAI patterns; credential files ~/.azure, ~/.npmrc, ~/.netrc, ~/.git-credentials, ~/.docker/config.json, Hugging Face tokens; /proc/[0-9]*/environ scraping of other processes; Azure IMDS (169.254.169.254) and App Service IDENTITY_ENDPOINT managed-identity token requests across multiple resource audiences (management.azure.com, vault.azure.net, graph.microsoft.com, storage, etc.); and an ADO OIDC token-exchange POST using SYSTEM_ACCESSTOKEN against SYSTEM_OIDCREQUESTURI. Package metadata impersonates Microsoft and mimics the real microsoft/agent-framework README as cover. The name resembles the legitimate Microsoft package.

## Source: kam193 (7170b55e6541c89d914a388534b7ccaeb303abb46def27bda667f5ad2051ed5d)
Versions 1.26.1, 1.26.2 were compromised.


Compromised versions use PTH file to trigger malicious actions on every Python process startup. It then exfiltrates environment variables, credential files and tokens from cloud metadata endpoints.


---

Category: MALICIOUS - The campaign has clearly malicious intent, like infostealers.


Campaign: 2026-11-compr-agent-framework


Reasons (based on the campaign):


 - exfiltration-env-variables


 - obfuscation


 - exfiltration-cloud-tokens


 - exfiltration-credentials


 - compromised-package


 - abuses-pth

---

Credit: [OpenSSF](https://github.com/ossf/malicious-packages) ([source](https://github.com/ossf/malicious-packages/blob/5f547b67f2daa8aa50d74a937b4c2077cccc495b/osv/malicious/pypi/agent-framework/MAL-2026-20101.json))

週間ダウンロード数: 約 39,963
items.ai_analysis:
【状況】Microsoft公式のPyPIパッケージ agent-framework の正規パッケージが乗っ取られ、2026年11月17日に公開された1.26.1と1.26.2に認証情報を盗むコードが入っていました。どちらも削除済みで、latestは安全な1.26.0に戻っています。ただしpip/uvやCIのキャッシュ、社内ミラーからはまだ入る可能性があります。importしなくても、インストールしただけで実行されます。盗まれる対象は環境変数、~/.azure・.npmrc・.git-credentials など、AzureマネージドIDのトークン、Azure DevOps/GitHub ActionsのOIDCトークンで、外部のwebhook.siteへ送られます。犯人がアップロードに使った認証情報を無効化済みかは未確認です。

【影響範囲】agent-framework 1.26.1と1.26.2のみです。1.26.0以前は影響なし。依存先の agent-framework-core 1.26.0 は変更されていません。

【対応策】
1. lockfile、CIの実行ログ、pip freeze の結果で 1.26.1/1.26.2 を探してください。site-packages に agent_framework_meta.pth か af_runtime_diag.pth があれば感染しています。見つかったら削除し、==1.26.0 に固定したうえで、その環境から読めた秘密情報（Azure・AWS・GitHub・PyPI/npmのトークン、CI/Actionsのシークレット）をすべて再発行してください。11/17 20:35 UTC以降のEntraのサインインログとロール割り当ても確認してください。
2. 「最新版に上げる」だけでは安全になりません。バージョンを固定し、キャッシュと社内ミラーからも該当版を消してください。Pythonプロセスからwebhook.siteへの通信と、環境変数 _AF_TEL=1 を監視してください。

【各告知の関係】
GitHub Advisory/OSV：悪性パッケージの告知（修正版なし。1.26.0に戻す）
Microsoft（開発元）：GitHubのIssueで該当版を取り下げ、調査中と回答
StepSecurity・Socketなど：セキュリティ企業による分析

items.title: Malicious code in vant (npm)
items.description:
Ten versions of vant were published on 2024-12-19 between 00:41:47Z and 01:49:30Z by the npm user landluck, using npm 9.2.0: 4.9.11, 2.13.3, 3.6.13, 4.9.12, 3.6.14, 2.13.4, 4.9.13, 4.9.14, 3.6.15 and 2.13.5. Each one adds an install hook, "postinstall": "node lib/utils/support.js", which no earlier release of vant had. Clean releases by the maintainer followed from 02:20:40Z the same day (4.9.15, 3.6.16, 2.13.6). The ten versions are deprecated on the registry with the message "Contains security vulnerabilities, do not use" but remain installable.

Content (all ten tarballs read statically, integrity matching the registry; nothing was executed): every version is the clean 4.9.10 build with every other file byte-identical to 4.9.10, package.json "version" set to the target number, the postinstall hook added, and one added file, lib/utils/support.js. The 2.13.x and 3.6.x versions therefore ship 4.x code under 2.x and 3.x numbers. lib/utils/support.js is a single obfuscated line in two builds:
- sha256 92c486bcc03a68b5b0b914417bca063bf40ad08db246a1c3f11bb8999afedf43, 609,615 bytes: 4.9.11, 2.13.3, 3.6.13
- sha256 b91f82dc09bae8c3e72e4cf8f6778a8530417bf5fed3a7e2df49e8b85950eb85, 609,441 bytes: 4.9.12, 3.6.14, 2.13.4, 4.9.13, 4.9.14, 3.6.15, 2.13.5

The script uses child_process and writes and marks files executable. Strings in both builds: the XMRig 6.22.2 linux-static-x64 release download from github.com, the endpoint 80.78.28.72/tokens (https in the first build, http in the second), an IP lookup at ipinfo.io/json, the GitHub API path api.github.com/repos/youzan/vant/git/blobs/, and the local paths /tmp/vant_helper and /tmp/xmrig. Classification: cryptocurrency miner dropper run from an install hook.

This compromise was reported publicly on the same day, in the vant maintainers' notice (youzan/vant discussion #13273, 2024-12-19T01:39Z) and in vendor write-ups such as Sonatype's, which lists the same ten versions. ossf/malicious-packages issue #1628 asks for a record for eight of them; this record adds 4.9.11 and 3.6.15. At the time of writing no malware record for these versions exists in OSV or the GitHub Advisory Database.

---

Credit: [OpenSSF](https://github.com/ossf/malicious-packages) ([source](https://github.com/ossf/malicious-packages/blob/6e55eedf725a24f7642b70835be301ba435a5a51/osv/malicious/npm/vant/MAL-2026-20107.json))

週間ダウンロード数: 約 115,882
items.ai_analysis:
【状況】npm の UI ライブラリ vant に、2024-12-19 に乗っ取られた npm アカウント（landluck）から悪性版が 10 個公開されました。npm install の後に自動で動く処理（postinstall）で、Linux 向けの暗号通貨マイナー XMRig をダウンロードして実行します。外部の通信先は 80.78.28.72 と ipinfo.io です。実際に被害が出たかは未確認です。悪性版は非推奨になっていますが、今もインストールできます。同じ日に Rspack も同じ手口の被害を受けています。

【原因の部品】npm:vant（youzan/vant）。これを組み込んだ主な製品は未確認です。

【影響範囲】
・2.13.3〜2.13.5
・3.6.13〜3.6.15
・4.9.11〜4.9.14
（計 10 版）
修正後のクリーンな版は 2.13.6／3.6.16／4.9.15 です。

【対応策】
1. 最優先でやること
・package-lock.json／yarn.lock／pnpm-lock.yaml と CI のログで、上の版を 12/19 以降に入れていないか確認する
・該当した場合は、その端末と CI ランナーで次を確認する：/tmp/xmrig と /tmp/vant_helper の有無、xmrig のプロセス、上の通信先への通信
・該当した環境は作り直し、そこに置いていた秘密情報（npm・GitHub・クラウドのトークンなど）を再発行する
・vant をクリーン版に固定し、lockfile を作り直す
2. すぐ更新できない場合の回避策
・npm install --ignore-scripts でインストール時の処理を止める
・悪性の版をレジストリやプロキシで遮断する

【各告知の関係】
・vant 開発元（GitHub の discussion #13273）：侵害の公表とクリーン版の公開
・OpenSSF／GitHub（GHSA-j2hq-r459-pg6f）：悪性パッケージとしての登録
・Sonatype などのセキュリティ企業：分析記事（注意喚起）

【出典】
https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-j2hq-r459-pg6f
https://thehackernews.com/2024/12/rspack-npm-packages-compromised-with.html

items.title: Confection 0.4.0 - 0.4.7 - Unauthenticated RCE via Write Key Option
items.description: The Confection WordPress Cable WordPress plugin from 0.4.0 to 0.4.7 does not perform any capability or nonce checks before saving its settings and writing one of them, unmodified, into a standalone PHP file that it then serves, allowing unauthenticated users to execute arbitrary PHP code on the server.
items.ai_analysis:
【状況】WordPressプラグイン「Confection（Confection WordPress Cable）」に、ログインなしでサーバ上で任意のPHPコードを実行される脆弱性（CVE-2026-115252、CVSS 10.0）があります。設定を保存するときに権限確認とnonce（不正リクエスト防止用のトークン）の確認がなく、設定値の1つがそのままPHPファイルに書き込まれて公開されます。WPScanは2026年11月6日に公開し、修正版は出ていません（「No known fix」）。実際の悪用はKEV（米CISAの悪用確認済みリスト）未掲載で、報告も未確認です。攻撃コード（PoC）はWPScanが2027年2月4日に公開する予定です。

【原因の部品】Confectionプラグイン（WordPress.org上の開発者名は getconfection）。単体のプラグインで、他の製品に組み込まれているという情報は未確認です。

【影響範囲】0.4.0〜0.4.7。0.4.7は2023年7月から更新がなく、最新版の0.4.7も影響を受けます。修正版は未確認です。

【対応策】
1. 全WordPressサイトの管理画面のプラグイン一覧か `wp plugin list` で導入の有無を確認し、入っていれば今日中に無効化して削除してください。修正版がないため、更新では対処できません。
2. すぐ削除できない場合は、WAFやIP制限で外部からwp-admin（管理画面）とプラグインへのアクセスを遮断してください。導入済みだった場合は侵害を前提に、次を確認してください。
・プラグインのディレクトリに見覚えのないPHPファイルや改ざんがないか
・不審な管理者アカウントがないか
・アクセスログに不審な記録がないか
不審な点があれば、DBの認証情報、WordPressの鍵、管理者のパスワードを変更してください。

【各告知の関係】
・WPScan：脆弱性データベースとしての一次公開
・開発元：アドバイザリも修正版もなく、未確認
・VulDB、Rapid7：WPScanの内容を転載したDB
・国内の注意喚起：未確認

【出典】
https://wpscan.com/vulnerability/aebe20c3-bc02-4082-bda8-bbaa01550925/
https://profiles.wordpress.org/getconfection/

items.title: VMWare vCenter Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
items.description:
VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service.
Affected versions: 9.1.x (fixed in 9.1.1.0200); 9.0.x (fixed in 9.0.2.0200); 8.0 (fixed in 8.0 U3m); 5.x (fixed in 5.2.5).
Telco Cloud Platform 3.0, 4.x, 5.0.x, 5.1.x, 5.2 and Telco Cloud Infrastructure 3.0 are also affected (see KB463116).

Out of bounds write in Tint in Google Chrome prior to 158.0.8127.36 allowed a remote attacker to potentially execute arbitrary code outside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Medium)
items.ai_analysis:
【状況】
11月17日公開の Chrome 158 安定版で直った204件の脆弱性のうちの1件です。Tint という部品に境界外書き込みの不具合があり、細工したWebページを開くだけで、サンドボックスの外でコードを実行される恐れがあります（CVSS 9.6。Chromium の評価は Medium）。Google の告知に実際の悪用の記載はなく、CISA KEV にも未掲載です。

【原因の部品】
Tint（Google 開発。Chromium 内の WebGPU 用シェーダ変換部品）
組み込み先：Microsoft Edge、WebView2、Electron アプリなどの Chromium 系製品

【影響範囲】
・Chrome 158.0.8127.36 未満（Windows / Mac / Linux）
・Edge、WebView2、Electron で直った版は未確認（Edge 158 は11月19日公開予定）

【対応策】
1. 最優先でやること
・Chrome を 158.0.8127.36 以上に上げて再起動する（Windows / Mac は .37 もある）
・管理コンソールで、全端末が上がったかを確認する
・Edge、WebView2、社内の Electron アプリは、各社の更新が出たらすぐ当てる
2. すぐ更新できない場合
・公式の回避策は未確認です
・それまでは、信頼できないサイトの閲覧を制限してください

【各告知の関係】
・Google（Chrome Releases）：元の部品の修正。Chrome 158 で修正
・CVE.org / EUVD：同じ件の CVE 登録情報（別の件ではない）
・Microsoft（Edge）：組み込み製品の更新。この CVE についての告知は未確認

【出典】
https://chromereleases.googleblog.com/2026/11/stable-channel-update-for-desktop_01699533288.html
https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-131077

Out of bounds read in ANGLE in Google Chrome on on Android prior to 158.0.8127.36 allowed a remote attacker to potentially execute arbitrary code outside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: High)

Use after free in HID in Google Chrome prior to 158.0.8127.36 allowed a remote attacker leveraging social engineering to execute arbitrary code outside the sandbox via a crafted Chrome extension. (Chromium security severity: Medium)
items.ai_analysis:
【状況】
Google Chrome の HID 処理に解放済みメモリ使用（use-after-free）の脆弱性があります（CVE-2026-131043、CVSS 9.6、Chrome の評価は Medium）。利用者が細工された拡張機能を入れると、サンドボックス外でコードを実行される恐れがあります。Google は 11/17 公開の Chrome 158 で修正しました。Chrome 158 は 204 件の脆弱性を修正し、うち 6 件が Criticalです。実際の悪用は Google の告知になく、CISA KEV にも未登録です（EPSS 0.4%）。ただし案件データには「エクスプロイトの参考情報あり」の印があり、内容は未確認です。

【原因の部品】
Chromium（Google）の HID 機能

【影響範囲】
・Chrome：158.0.8127.36 より前
　修正版は Linux 158.0.8127.36、Win/Mac 158.0.8127.36/.37
・Edge など他の Chromium 系ブラウザ：修正版は未確認。Edge 158 は 11/19 にリリースされましたが、この CVE を修正したかは未確認です

【対応策】
1. Chrome を 158.0.8127.36 以上に更新し、再起動させる。配信は数日〜数週間かけて段階的に行われるため、管理ツールで手動配信してバージョンを確認する
2. すぐ更新できない場合は、ポリシーで拡張機能を許可リスト制にし、未承認の拡張機能を入れさせない。社員にも見知らぬ拡張機能を入れないよう注意喚起する

【各告知の関係】
・Google Chrome Releases：Chrome 本体の修正（一次情報）
・Microsoft など他の Chromium 系ベンダー：この件の告知は未確認

https://chromereleases.googleblog.com/2026/11/stable-channel-update-for-desktop_01699533288.html

items.title: OpenBSD OpenSSH Unexpected Status Code or Return Value Vulnerability
items.description: sshd in OpenSSH before 10.6p2 on Linux, when musl libc is used without PAM, lacks a workaround for a password authentication bypass (related to misinterpretation of whether a string is intended to be a password hash). For some configurations of accounts, any password between 256 and 1024 characters succeeds. An example of a platform using musl libc without PAM is Alpine Linux.

items.title: nginxWebUI 3.0.0 < 3.5.8 Authentication Bypass RCE via runCmd
items.description: nginxWebUI 3.0.0 before 3.5.8 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to reach the /AdminPage/conf/runCmd endpoint by using a case-variant path that evades the case-sensitive /adminPage/ login filter. Attackers can pass OS commands through the cmd parameter, which are executed via /bin/sh with insufficient filtering of & and $() characters, achieving remote code execution. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-14.
items.ai_analysis:
【状況】nginxWebUI（nginx を Web 画面で設定する管理ツール）に認証回避の脆弱性があります。ログイン不要で、外部から OS コマンドを実行されるおそれがあります。悪用は Shadowserver が 2023-10-14 に観測したと CVE の説明にあります（KEV には未登録）。PoC と検知テンプレートは公開済みです。

【原因の部品】nginxWebUI 本体（開発元: cym1102、OSS）。nginx 本体の脆弱性ではありません。本件を組み込んだ他社製品は未確認です。

【影響範囲】from 3.0.0 before 3.5.8。3.5.8 で修正済みで、修正コミットではパス判定を大文字小文字を区別しない方式に変えています。

【対応策】
1. nginxWebUI の稼働有無を棚卸しし、3.5.8 以降に更新してください。後の版でも別の CVE が出ており、up to 4.3.7が対象とされる件もあるため、最新版を推奨します。あわせて、管理画面へのアクセスログに大文字小文字を変えた adminPage へのアクセスがないか、不審なプロセスや追加ファイルがないかを確認してください。侵害が疑われる場合は、管理者パスワードとサーバ上の秘密鍵・証明書を再発行してください。
2. すぐ更新できない場合は、管理画面をインターネットに公開せず、VPN や IP 制限の内側に置いてください。それもできなければ停止してください。

【各告知の関係】
・cym1102: 元の部品の修正（3.5.8）
・VulnCheck: CNA として CVE を採番・公開
・Sangfor FarSight Labs: 注意喚起（Release Date June 29, 2023）
同じ件を指しています。

【出典】
https://github.com/cym1102/nginxWebUI/commit/6b8c9bceb0d210632a35cd324db6b43caf442a23
https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-54419

items.description: !MISSING CAUSE! in Chromoting in Google Chrome prior to 158.0.8127.36 allowed a remote attacker to potentially execute arbitrary code outside the sandbox via crafted network traffic. (Chromium security severity: Low)
items.ai_analysis:
【状況】Googleは11/17、Chrome 158.0.8127.36でChromotingの脆弱性CVE-2026-131037を修正しました。Googleの告知での原因は「認証要求の制限不備」です（CVE記録ではCWE-307＝認証試行回数の制限不足）。Googleの深刻度は「Low」、通知データのCVSSは9.0（任意コード実行の可能性）で、評価が大きく食い違っています。Googleの告知に悪用の記載はありません。CISA KEV（悪用確認済み一覧）には未登録で、EPSS（悪用予測値）は0.35%です。データ上は「エクスプロイト参照あり」ですが、内容は未確認です。詳細は非公開です。

【原因の部品】ChromotingはChromium内のコンポーネントで、開発元はGoogleです（ライブラリではありません）。一般にChromeリモートデスクトップの基盤とされていますが、今回の出典では未確認です。

【影響範囲】

items.description: The Chatterbug Forms – Fast, Flexible WordPress Form Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Arbitrary File Upload in all versions up to, and including, 1.0.2 via the cbforms_check_form_submissions function. items.title: WP connect Plugins (Various Versions - Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution via Backdoored Software
items.description: Several plugins for WordPress published by WP connect (Orders Sync to Airtable for WooCommerce, Add-On for Contact Form 7 to Notion, WP Sync for Notion – Notion to WordPress, Add-On for Contact Form 7 to Airtable, Add-on Brevo for Gravity Forms, and Air WP Sync – Airtable to WordPress) contain embedded malicious code (a backdoor) in the versions listed. The affected releases unconditionally load a backdoor module (includes/airwp-online.php) that runs on every request via the 'init' hook and on a half-hourly WP-Cron event, sends site information (site URL, PHP, WordPress and OS versions, and the server user) to a remote command-and-control server at tascredit-pay.com with TLS certificate verification disabled, and executes the PHP code returned by that server via eval(). The module also accepts queued commands that run shell commands, read, write and delete arbitrary files, query arbitrary database tables, dump the users table including password hashes, drop a webshell into the uploads directory, and install persistent hourly code execution. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers in control of the remote server, or able to intercept its traffic, to execute arbitrary code on the server and fully compromise affected sites. All affected plugins have been closed on WordPress.org and no patched versions are available; we strongly recommend uninstalling them and running a complete malware scan.

items.title: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition Integer Overflow or Wraparound Vulnerability
items.description: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 19.2 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2 that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server via a specially crafted regular expression in a CI/CD configuration, due to insufficient regular expression validation.
vendor_products: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition
items.ai_analysis:
【状況】GitLab CE/EE（自社で運用するセルフマネージド版）に、認証なしでサーバ上のコードを実行される脆弱性があります（CVSS 10.0）。原因はCI/CD設定内の正規表現の処理です。CISAは10/29に「悪用が確認された脆弱性」の一覧に追加しました。Alpine Linuxは自社のGitLabが10/20〜21に攻撃を試みられたと公表しています。GitLab.com とDedicatedは対応不要と報じられています。

【原因の部品】Ruby内蔵の正規表現エンジン「Onigmo」（開発元：Ruby）。GitLabは公式パッケージに同梱するRubyに修正を当てて対処しました。正規表現を外部からの文字列で組み立てるRubyアプリも影響を受けます。

【影響範囲】
・GitLab 19.2〜19.2.7、19.3〜19.3.4、19.4〜19.4.1
・Ruby 4.0.9未満、3.4.12未満、3.3.13未満
・Ruby 3.2以前はサポート終了のため修正版なし

【対応策】
1. GitLabを19.4.2/19.3.5/19.2.8以上に更新してください。19.4.3/19.3.6/19.2.9が必要とする記事もあるため、最新版を推奨します（どちらが正しいかは未確認）。ソースから入れた環境や自作コンテナはGitLabを更新しても直らないため、Ruby 3.3.13/3.4.12/4.0.9以上にも上げてください。悪用が確認されているので、侵害されていないかの調査もしてください。
2. 回避策：GitLab公式の回避策は未確認です。RubyのRegexp.timeout設定では防げないと報じられています。

【各告知の関係】
・GitLab：組み込み製品の更新（19.4.2ほか。同梱Rubyに修正を当てたもの）
・Ruby：元の部品の修正（10/23。CVE-2026-89078/93577/110264とまとめて告知）
・CISA：悪用確認済み一覧への登録（注意喚起）
・Alpine Linux：被害の報告と、自社配布イメージの更新

When NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source is configured as a mail proxy, undisclosed traffic can cause a use-after-free in an nginx worker process. Additionally, attackers can execute code on systems with Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) disabled or when the attacker can bypass ASLR.

Impact:
A remote unauthenticated attacker may crash an nginx worker process or corrupt its memory, disrupting service. Remote code execution is a potential impact. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only.



Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

This issue occurs when NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source is configured as a proxy, the proxied server name includes variables, and a Server Side Includes (SSI) or mirror directive sends a subrequest to a location that resolves the same server name. Under these conditions, a specially crafted HTTP request may cause a use-after-free condition in a worker process. An attacker may also be able to execute code if Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) is disabled or the attacker can bypass ASLR.

Impact: 
An attacker could leverage this vulnerability to crash the NGINX worker process, corrupt its memory, or perform remote code execution (RCE)



Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

items.title: Acadlix LMS <= 1.1.9 - Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Deletion via 'delete_file_data.file_path' Parameter
items.description: The Acadlix LMS – AI Quiz Maker, Online Exam & Course Plugin for WordPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to arbitrary file deletion due to insufficient file path validation in the post_delete_assessment_file_by_id function in all versions up to, and including, 1.1.9. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to delete arbitrary files on the server, which can easily lead to remote code execution when the right file is deleted (such as wp-config.php). The route's permission callback only verifies a generic wp_rest nonce that the plugin itself emits inside the public acadlixOptions JavaScript object on every frontend page, effectively reducing the authentication requirement to unauthenticated.
vendor_products: acadlix Acadlix LMS – AI Quiz Maker, Online Exam & Course Plugin for WordPress

items.title: ELEX WordPress HelpDesk & Customer Ticketing System <= 3.3.8 - Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Deletion via 'ticket_attachment_path' Parameter
items.description: The ELEX WordPress HelpDesk & Customer Ticketing System plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to arbitrary file deletion due to insufficient file path validation in the factory_reset function in all versions up to, and including, 3.3.8 This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to delete arbitrary files on the server, which can easily lead to remote code execution when the right file is deleted (such as wp-config.php). This vulnerability is exploitable via a two-step chain: an unauthenticated attacker first stores an arbitrary ticket_attachment_path value by submitting a ticket through the nopriv eh_crm_new_ticket_post AJAX endpoint (whose nonce is publicly exposed via the [wsdesk_support] shortcode), then triggers the factory_reset routine via a GET request to wp-admin/admin.php?page=wsdesk_factory_reset, which is guarded only by is_admin() — a request-type check — rather than a capability check, causing unlink() to be called on the attacker-supplied path.
vendor_products: elextensions ELEX WordPress HelpDesk & Customer Ticketing System

items.description: Use after free in WebView in Google Chrome on on Android prior to 158.0.8127.36 allowed a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code outside the sandbox via crafted network traffic. (Chromium security severity: Medium)
items.ai_analysis:
【状況】
Android版ChromeのWebViewに、解放済みメモリを使ってしまう不具合（解放後使用）があります。細工された通信を受けると、サンドボックス（隔離環境）の外で任意のコードを実行される恐れがあります。CVSSは9.0ですが、Chromium側の重要度はMediumです。2026/11/17公開のChrome 158で修正済みです。悪用の報告はなく、CISAの悪用確認済みリスト（KEV）にも載っていません（EPSS約0.4%）。

【原因の部品】
GoogleのChromiumに含まれるWebView。Android版Chromeと、Android System WebViewを使うAndroidアプリに影響する可能性があります。

【影響範囲】
・Android版Chrome 158.0.8127.36未満
・Android System WebViewの修正版：公式告知では未確認
・PC版（Win/Mac/Linux）への影響：未確認（CVEの説明はAndroidのみ）

【対応策】
1. MDMで社用AndroidのChromeを158.0.8127.42（Android向け公開版）以上にし、Android System WebViewもGoogle Playで最新にする。PCのChromeも158.0.8127.36/.37にする（この更新は他に204件のセキュリティ修正を含む）。
2. 更新できるまでは、信頼できない公衆Wi‑Fiの利用を控え、WebViewを使う業務アプリの利用を絞る。

【各告知の関係】

items.title: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software Unchecked Return Value to NULL Pointer Dereference Vulnerability
items.description: A vulnerability in the Remote Access SSL VPN service of Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) Software and Cisco Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD) Software could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause the device to reload unexpectedly, resulting in a denial of service (DoS) condition. This vulnerability is due to logic errors when secondary authentication is configured on a tunnel group. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a crafted request when connecting to the SSL remote access VPN. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to cause the affected device to reload, resulting in a DoS condition.
vendor_products: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software
items.ai_analysis:
【状況】
Cisco ASA/FTDのSSL VPNに脆弱性があり、認証なしで外部から機器を再起動させられます（DoS、CVSS 8.6）。Ciscoは10月に実際の悪用を確認し、CISAも10/29に悪用確認済みの一覧（KEV）に追加しました。被害は機器の停止で、情報漏えいは対象外です。

【原因の部品】
Cisco製のASA/FTDソフトそのものの不具合です（他社部品の組み込み経由ではありません）。

【影響範囲】
次の2条件を満たす機器が対象です。
・SSL VPNが有効（webvpn と enable <IF>）
・トンネルグループに secondary-authentication-server-group（二次認証）が設定されている
 - tunnel-group-list enable があれば全グループを確認
 - なければ DefaultWEBVPNGroup を確認

修正版
・ASA：9.16.4.104 / 9.18.4.96 / 9.20.4.50 / 9.22.3.200 / 9.23.1.48 / 9.24.1.27 / 9.24.10.1
・FTD：7.0.11 / 7.2.13 / 7.4.9 / 7.6.7 / 7.7.14 / 10.0.3 / 10.1.1

影響なし：FMC、CDFW、cdFMC、Secure Access

【対応策】
1. 全ASA/FTDの設定を確認し、該当する機器は修正版へ更新してください（Cisco Software Checkerで確認できます）。原因不明の再起動がなかったかも確認してください。
2. 回避策はありません。暫定の緩和策は次のとおりです。
・DefaultWEBVPNGroupで二次認証を使っていない：no tunnel-group-list enable
・使っている：no secondary-authentication-server-group
二次認証を外すとVPNの安全性が下がるため、あくまで暫定です。

【各告知の関係】
・Cisco PSIRT：開発元として修正版を公開
・CISA：KEVに追加（注意喚起）
・NVD：CVEの登録情報（本文は取得できず未確認）
・国内の注意喚起：未確認

items.title: Atlassian Multiple Products Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties Vulnerability
items.description: This is a vulnerability in Bitbucket Data Center, Confluence Data Center, Jira Service Management Data Center, Jira Software Data Center, Bamboo Data Center. Crowd Data Center, Crucible and Fisheye. This Arbitrary File Access vulnerability allows an unauthenticated attacker to access specific files within the web application root directory in affected versions. Exploitation requires prior knowledge of the target file's exact name and path; this vulnerability does not allow attackers to enumerate or list directory contents. The vulnerability must be addressed for affected versions of: -- Bitbucket Data Center, introduced in version >= 4.6.0, fix versions: 9.4.26, 10.2.8, 10.5.1 -- Confluence Data Center, introduced in version >= 5.10.0, fix versions 9.2.26, 10.2.19 -- Crowd Data Center, introduced in version >= 2.11.0, fix versions 6.3.7, 7.0.3, 7.1.7, 7.2.4 -- Jira Software Data Center, introduced in version >= 7.1.0, fix versions 9.12.40, 10.3.26, 11.3.12 -- Jira Service Management Data Center, introduced in version >= 3.1.0, fix versions 5.12.40, 10.3.26, 11.3.12 -- Bamboo Data Center >= 7.0.1, fix versions 10.2.24, 12.1.12 -- Crucible, fix versions 4.9.15 -- Fisheye, fix version 4.9.15 -- Exploitation requires prior knowledge of the target file's exact name and path. Session serializer mismatch can lead to remote code execution.

Session upload progress, when enabled, can store attacker-controlled data in a session key using the php_binary or php_serialize session serializer. If the same session is later read with the php serializer, because session.serialize_handler is changed at runtime or differs between applications sharing a session store, bytes inside the key can be passed to the unserializer. A remote attacker able to submit a multipart upload can inject objects, which may lead to code execution when the reading application contains a suitable gadget chain, or to session corruption or denial of service.

This issue affects PHP versions before 8.2.36, 8.3.* before 8.3.37, 8.4.* before 8.4.28 and 8.5.* before 8.5.13.

items.title: Apache Axis Unsafe Reflection Vulnerability
items.description:
** UNSUPPORTED WHEN ASSIGNED ** Deserialization of an inbound SOAP fault in Apache Axis 1.x allows unauthenticated remote class instantiation. When a SOAP <Fault> carries a <detail><exceptionName> element, Axis loads the named class and, if a String <data> element is also present, instantiates it through its String constructor before checking that it is an AxisFault. Loading alone runs the class's static initializer. With a suitable class on the application's classpath this leads to remote code execution. The fault is parsed while the engine resolves the target service, before any per-service handler chain runs, so authentication handlers configured on a service do not protect against it. This affects all Apache Axis 1.x versions through 1.4.



As Axis 1 has been EOL we recommend you migrate to a different SOAP engine, such as Apache Axis 2/Java. Alternatively you could use a build of Axis with the patch from https://github.com/apache/axis-axis1-java/commit/41f3b4e8d04e310ca81f86b92630ab2c11d608bd applied. The Apache Axis project does not expect to create an Axis 1.x release fixing this problem.

items.title: Apache Roller Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
items.description:
Deserialization of Untrusted Data in Apache Roller versions 4.0.0 through 6.1.4 allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code. The XML-RPC endpoint accepts vendor extension types and deserializes them before authenticating the requester.

This is the same vulnerability as CVE-2026-82384, which listed only Apache Roller 6.1.5 as affected. This issue is being actively exploited.

Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.6 or later, which disables the extension types and rejects XML-RPC requests when the XML-RPC feature is disabled.

Users who cannot upgrade right away should set "enabledForExtensions" to "false" in WEB-INF/web.xml, or remove the "/roller-services/xmlrpc" servlet mapping, and restart Roller. Disabling XML-RPC in the administration UI is not enough, because older versions deserialize the request before checking that setting.

Vulnerability in the Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition product of Oracle Java SE (component: Compiler).  Supported versions that are affected are Oracle Java SE: 8u511b33-perf, 17.0.21.0.3, 21.0.13.0.3, 25.0.5.0.3, 27.0.1.0.3; Oracle GraalVM for JDK: 17.0.21.0.3 and  21.0.13.0.3; Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition: 21.3.20.0.3. Difficult to exploit vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via multiple protocols to compromise Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition. Note: This vulnerability can only be exploited by supplying data to APIs in the specified Component without using Untrusted Java Web Start applications or Untrusted Java applets, such as through a web service. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 8.1 (Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H).

This issue affects NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source configurations that use HTTP/2. When NGINX processes undisclosed traffic, the flow control window can exceed the allowed threshold, potentially resulting in a heap buffer overflow typically followed by an NGINX worker segmentation fault. Additionally, attackers can execute code on systems with Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) disabled or when the attacker can bypass ASLR.

Impact: An attacker could leverage this vulnerability to crash the NGINX worker process, corrupt its memory, or potentially execute code remotely. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only.



Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

When NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source is configured to use HTTP/2 for client connections and proxy client requests to a backend, a specially crafted request can result in use-after-free in the worker process, if this process is running low on worker_connections. Additionally, attackers can execute code on systems with Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) disabled or when the attacker can bypass ASLR.




Impact:



This vulnerability may allow remote attackers to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) on the NGINX system or may allow a code execution. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only.



Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

items.title: Perforce Puppet Enterprise Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
items.description: Deserialization of untrusted data in the report-processing code of Puppet, as used by Puppet Server, in the affected releases, allows a client that holds any CA-signed agent certificate to execute arbitrary code on the Puppet Server as its service user by submitting a report containing a crafted rich-data type via PUT request. Where the certificate authority autosigns requests without strong verification, an unauthenticated network attacker can obtain such a certificate.

items.title: Chatterbug Forms <= 1.1 - Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Deletion via Content-Disposition 'filename='
items.description: The Chatterbug Forms – Fast, Flexible WordPress Form Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to arbitrary file deletion due to insufficient file path validation in the cbforms_delete_uploaded_files function in all versions up to, and including, 1.1 This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to delete arbitrary files on the server, which can easily lead to remote code execution when the right file is deleted (such as wp-config.php). Exploitation requires an administrator to delete the attacker-planted form entry, and the attacker must know or be able to guess the absolute path of a file writable by the PHP process. Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.
vendor_products: sameh101 Chatterbug Forms – Fast, Flexible WordPress Form Builder

This is due to insufficient file type validation before processing uploaded files. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to upload files that may be executable, which makes remote code execution possible.

items.title: SignalWire FreeSwitch Code Injection Vulnerability
items.description: FreeSWITCH is a Software Defined Telecom Stack enabling the digital transformation from proprietary telecom switches to a software implementation that runs on any commodity hardware. Prior to 1.11.3, sofia_presence_handle_sip_i_message() split the To user of an inbound SIP MESSAGE on a plus sign and treated the left side as a chat protocol selector. Selecting the api chat proto reached switch_api_execute(), allowing a peer whose MESSAGE was accepted to run FreeSWITCH API commands, including operating-system command sinks, with the daemon's privileges. Inbound chat is enabled on the stock internal and external profiles, and any authenticated profile account is sufficient; stock directory users without password material can also remove that barrier in affected configurations. The flaw permits configuration and credential disclosure, arbitrary call control, and command execution, and exploitation has been observed in the wild. This issue is fixed in version 1.11.3.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

ipv4: free inet_opt and ireq_opt after an RCU grace period

tcp_v4_syn_recv_sock() transfers ownership of ireq->ireq_opt to the
child socket (newinet->inet_opt) without copying it.

Another cpu can concurrently process a retransmitted SYN for the same
request socket, and send a SYNACK from tcp_check_req().
tcp_v4_send_synack() and inet_csk_route_req() read ireq->ireq_opt
under rcu_read_lock() only, and ip_build_and_send_pkt() and
ip_options_build() then read opt->optlen twice.

Note that the SYNACK timer itself is not an issue: it holds a
reference on its request socket, and inet_csk_reqsk_queue_drop()
calls timer_delete_sync() before the child can be freed.

Since commit 079096f103fa ("tcp/dccp: install syn_recv requests
into ehash table"), request sockets are processed without holding
the listener lock, so nothing prevents the child socket from being
freed while the SYNACK is still being built. TCP child sockets do
not have SOCK_RCU_FREE, and inet_sock_destruct() frees inet_opt
with a plain kfree(), leading to a use-after-free in
ip_options_build().

A similar issue exists with request socket migration
(net.ipv4.tcp_migrate_req=1, or a BPF_SK_REUSEPORT_SELECT_OR_MIGRATE
program). reqsk_timer_handler() clones the request socket with
inet_reqsk_clone(), so that the old request socket and its clone
share the same ireq_opt, then reqsk_migrate_reset() clears the
pointer in the old one. Another cpu holding a reference on the old
request socket can still be using these options (sending a SYNACK,
or creating a child in tcp_v4_syn_recv_sock()) when the clone is
freed, and tcp_v4_reqsk_destructor() also uses a plain kfree().

Readers already use RCU, and other paths replacing inet_opt
(do_ip_setsockopt(), cipso_v4_sock_setattr()...) already use
kfree_rcu(). Use kfree_rcu() in inet_sock_destruct() and
tcp_v4_reqsk_destructor() as well.

IPv6 is not affected by the first issue, because tcp_v6_syn_recv_sock()
duplicates the options. tcp_v6_reqsk_destructor() has the same
migration issue with ipv6_opt, which is only set by CALIPSO. This
will be addressed in a separate patch.

items.title: GPUStack Improper Authentication Vulnerability
items.description: GPUStack is an open-source GPU cluster manager for AI model serving and GPU instance provisioning. Prior to 2.2.0, get_current_user in gpustack/api/auth.py treated a loopback request source as the built-in administrator when force_auth_localhost was false, which was the default. A remote request could appear to originate from 127.0.0.1 because client_ip_getter accepted a same-host reverse proxy peer or a client-supplied X-GPUStack-Real-IP loopback value. The bypass allowed unauthenticated administrative access, including user and model changes, persistent administrator API-key creation, disclosure of worker and cloud-provider secrets, and code execution through POST /v2/inference-backends/from-yaml. Exploitation was observed in the wild against a 2.1.1 deployment. This issue is fixed in version 2.2.0.

items.title: Appointment Booking Plugin <= 5.7.6 - Unauthenticated Authentication Bypass via Account Takeover via 'IS NOT NULL' Sentinel in 'password_reset_token' Parameter
items.description: The Appointment Booking Plugin – LatePoint | Calendar & Scheduling for WordPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass via Account Takeover in all versions up to, and including, 5.7.6. This is due to the `OsModel::build_conditions_query()` function in `lib/models/model.php` comparing WHERE-clause values against the literal strings `'IS NULL'` and `'IS NOT NULL'` and concatenating a match directly into SQL without binding it as a parameter, a flaw that neither `sanitize_text_field()` nor the 5.7.5 `is_scalar()` hardening guard closes, since both pass the scalar sentinel through unchanged. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to send `params[password_reset_token]=IS NOT NULL` to the public `customer_cabinet__change_password` AJAX route to match every non-null `account_nonse` value, resolving to the lowest-id customer and overwriting that customer's password to an attacker-chosen value — granting full access to their bookings, orders, and PII, and, when the `wp_users_as_customers` option is enabled, takeover of the linked WordPress subscriber or customer-role account. The attacker can first identify the target customer's email by sending `params[order_intent_key]=IS NOT NULL` to the public `steps__start_from_order_intent` route, which returns the name and email from the first matching order intent, and can then self-arm the required 15-minute password-reset freshness window by triggering a reset for that customer directly.
vendor_products: latepoint Appointment Booking Plugin – LatePoint | Calendar & Scheduling for WordPress

An elevation of privilege vulnerability exists in the Network Driver Interface Specification (NDIS) when ndis.sys fails to check the length of a buffer prior to copying memory to it.
To exploit the vulnerability, in a local attack scenario, an attacker could run a specially crafted application to elevate the attacker's privilege level. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could run processes in an elevated context. However, an attacker must first gain access to the local system with the ability to execute a malicious application in order to exploit this vulnerability.
The security update addresses the vulnerability by changing how ndis.sys validates buffer length.

items.title: Joomla / WordPress Extension - acymailing.com - Missing authorization on subscription changes in AcyMailing 1.0.0 - 11.1.1
items.description: Joomla / WordPress Extension - acymailing.com - Missing authorization on subscription changes in AcyMailing 1.0.0 - 11.1.1 - An unauthenticated attacker who knows a subscriber's email address can unsubscribe that subscriber from one mailing list or from every mailing lists, without proving that the address is theirs. items.description: Joomla / WordPress Extension - acymailing.com - Exposure of sensitive information to an unauthorized actor in AcyMailing 6.0.0 - 11.1.1 - Exposure of sensitive information to an unauthorized actor in AcyMailing 6.0.0 through 11.1.1. An unauthenticated attacker who knows a subscriber's email address can read that subscriber's record, including the per-subscriber secret key that authorises the subscription management links. Holding that key, the attacker can act as that subscriber on those endpoints, which includes triggering the GDPR data export and the GDPR account deletion where those options are enabled.
vendor_products: Datasolution AcyMailing extension for Joomla and WordPress

items.description:
When using the listen directive with the ssl parameter in the http block with TLSv1.3 enabled, an attacker can use a specially crafted TLS connection to cause an infinite loop in the NGINX worker process while reading the HTTP request body. As a result, the worker process stops accepting new connections and processing existing connections. Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

Impact: This vulnerability allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) of NGINX. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only.



Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

items.title: python-markdown2 through 2.5.5 Denial of Service via Unclosed Inline Link Destinations
items.description: python-markdown2 through 2.5.5 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows remote users to exhaust CPU by submitting Markdown with unclosed inline link destinations. Attackers can submit repeated '[a](' or '![a](' sequences, causing _find_balanced to rescan the remaining document for each link and consume quadratic CPU time.

items.title: Python-Markdown 3.0 through 3.11.2 Denial of Service via Link Bracket Parsing
items.description: Python-Markdown 3.0 through 3.11.2 contains an algorithmic complexity vulnerability in inline link parsing that allows remote attackers to exhaust CPU through unmatched brackets. Attackers can submit short Markdown containing repeated [ or ![ characters, forcing LinkInlineProcessor.getText() and getLink() into quadratic scans that keep workers busy for minutes.

A xml injection (aka blind xpath injection) vulnerability in Fortinet FortiMail 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiMail 7.6.0 through 7.6.6 may allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via a specially crafted request.

items.title: NULL-pointer dereference (DoS) in nginx-http-flv-module
items.description: nginx-http-flv-module is a media streaming server based on nginx-rtmp-module. Prior to version 1.2.14, if a server received an HTTP/1.0 request without a header Host, which was permitted by HTTP core of Nginx, then r->headers_in.host was NULL, nginx-http-flv-module used r->headers_in.host->value to make a pseudo tcUrl, so NULL-pointer dereference happened. This issue has been patched in version 1.2.14.

items.title: Pillow: Memory DoS in TIFF and EXIF IFD parsing via overlapping tag data
items.description: Pillow is a Python imaging library. From 1.0 through 12.3.0, ImageFileDirectory_v2.load() in src/PIL/TiffImagePlugin.py retains a separate bytes object for each out-of-line IFD tag value without limiting the total data read or preventing distinct tags from referencing the same file region. A small crafted TIFF or EXIF-bearing JPEG, PNG, WebP, or MPO can therefore cause memory use quadratic in the input size. TIFF and some JPEG paths trigger parsing during Image.open(), while other formats are exposed when EXIF is requested, including through getexif() or ImageOps.exif_transpose(). The declared pixel dimensions do not bound this metadata allocation, so decompression-bomb checks do not prevent process memory exhaustion. This issue is fixed in version 13.0.0.

items.title: UnrealIRCd Improper Neutralization of Delimiters Vulnerability
items.description: The labeled-response module in UnrealIRCd 6.0.0 before 6.2.7.1 does not escape the IRCv3 "label" message tag when echoing it into replies, which allows any user on a network with two or more linked servers to inject server-to-server commands that are executed with server authority.

A incorrect authorization vulnerability in Fortinet FortiAuthenticator 8.0.0 through 8.0.3, FortiAuthenticator 6.6.0 through 6.6.10 may allow an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authorization checks and gain unauthorized access to restricted functionality.

items.title: Pillow: Heap buffer overflow saving TIFF with libtiff when tags override image size
items.description: Pillow is a Python imaging library. From 2.3.0 through 12.3.0, Pillow applications that save compressed TIFF images through libtiff can pass attacker-controlled image geometry tags to the encoder while allocating its row buffer from the actual image dimensions. The affected TiffImagePlugin._save path allows ImageWidth, ImageLength, or SamplesPerPixel from exif=, tiffinfo=, or a source TIFF IFD to make libtiff consume a larger scanline than the buffer supplied by ImagingLibTiffEncode. This can read heap memory into the generated TIFF or crash the process. When TIFF Predictor 2 is enabled, libtiff can rewrite the oversized scanline in place and corrupt memory beyond the buffer. A carried-over PlanarConfiguration value of 2 instead makes libtiff use a shorter scanline and can produce an undecodable output file, but is not established to cause the out-of-bounds access. This issue is fixed in version 13.0.0.

items.title: Pillow: Memory disclosure and segfault in libtiff encoder via crafted TIFF tags
items.description: Pillow is a Python imaging library. In versions through 12.3.0, the libtiff TIFF encoder can pass arguments to  TIFFSetField()  that do not match libtiff’s definition of the corresponding tag. When an application saves attacker-controlled image metadata through this encoder, crafted tag values can cause invalid memory reads, copying process memory into the encoded output or crashing the process. Applications that return the encoded output to an attacker can disclose that memory. The issue is reachable when re-saving compressed TIFF images and through certain conversions that preserve EXIF metadata into compressed TIFF output. This vulnerability is fixed in version 13.0.0.

items.title: Linux Kernel Missing Initialization of a Variable Vulnerability
items.description: Linux Kernel contains a missing initialization of a variable vulnerability that could allow for unintended modification of page-cache-backed data via failure to preserve the shared-fragment marker during socket buffer coalescing, causing ESP input processing to decrypt shared fragments in place. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 to implant PHP webshells and run commands as root.

Partially overwritten session files can lead to remote code execution.

The files session save handler, which is the default, writes updated session data into the existing session file without first clearing it. If a write is interrupted, the file can contain the beginning of the new session followed by the end of the old one, and bytes of an ordinary string can later be unserialized as objects. An attacker who can influence the session data, for example through session upload progress, and interrupt a write at a suitable point may inject objects, which can lead to code execution when the application contains a suitable gadget chain. Session data can also be corrupted.

This issue affects PHP versions before 8.2.36, 8.3.* before 8.3.37, 8.4.* before 8.4.28 and 8.5.* before 8.5.13.
Incorrect authorization in Active Directory Domain Services allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.

items.title: Node.js is vulnerable to a remote HTTP/2 denial of service via a reachable assertion in Http2Session teardown
items.description: A reachable assertion in Node.js HTTP/2 session teardown lets any unauthenticated client abort the server, over both TLS and cleartext. A client can arrange for an Http2Stream that still holds nghttp2-allocated header buffers to outlive its session: the stream is removed from the session's stream set but never detached, so when ~Http2Session() runs the memory accounting is nonzero and the CHECK_EQ(current_nghttp2_memory_, 0) assertion fails, terminating the process. The trigger needs only a default http2 server whose handler responds before the request body has ended, which is typical. It is a variant of CVE-2024-27983 that the earlier fix did not cover, because that fix only detached streams still tracked in the session. This vulnerability affects Node.js 26.x (since 26.9.0) and 24.x (since 24.22.0).

items.title: Node.js is vulnerable to cross-connection memory disclosure via TLS write re-entrancy in the HTTPS request parser
items.description: A re-entrancy flaw in Node.js HTTPS lets an unauthenticated client read memory belonging to other connections, including TLS private keys and other users' requests. TLSWrap::DoWrite() calls ClearOut() directly when asked to write zero bytes; if that write is issued from JavaScript running inside the HTTP parser's on_body callback, ClearOut() decrypts the next TLS record while the parser is still mid-body, re-entering llhttp_execute() and causing a use-after-free and an out-of-bounds heap read. The server then copies that freed or unrelated heap memory into the response for the request body. Triggering it requires a handler that calls res.flushHeaders() before the request body ends and later calls res.end() with a non-empty chunk, and reading the leaked memory requires any ordinary route that echoes or stores a request body. Cleartext node:http is not affected. This vulnerability affects Node.js 26.x, 24.x, and 22.x.

Use-after-free via repopulation of last_fatal_error_backtrace global after shutdown.

A fatal error raised while modified INI settings are restored during request shutdown can repopulate the stored fatal error backtrace after the executor has been cleaned up. The request memory is then freed, and a diagnostic emitted before executor initialization in a later request handled by the same PHP-FPM or mod_php worker can access the stale backtrace. The shutdown error requires per-path configuration of max_memory_limit, or of zlib.output_compression together with output_handler (which .user.ini can also set). The early diagnostic requires Apache per-directory configuration or, for PHP-FPM, a PHP_VALUE or PHP_ADMIN_VALUE parameter sent by the front end. This can cause memory corruption and worker crashes, and may allow remote code execution.

This issue affects PHP versions 8.5.* before 8.5.13.

items.title: WP STAGING <= 4.17.0 and WP STAGING Pro <= 6.17.0 - Authenticated (Subscriber+) PHP Object Injection to Remote Code Execution via Database Restore and Staging Reset
items.description: The WP STAGING and WP STAGING Pro plugins for WordPress are vulnerable to PHP Object Injection in all versions up to, and including, 4.17.0 and 6.17.0, respectively, via deserialization of untrusted input during database restore and staging reset. This is due to the database importer treating attacker-controlled text beginning with {WPSTG_BINARY} as trusted internal binary data and decoding its hexadecimal suffix into serialized bytes. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Subscriber-level access and above, to plant a malicious serialized object in their own profile. When an Administrator later performs an ordinary database-including restore or staging reset containing that value, and the restored profile metadata is loaded, either during the restore or in a later request, a built-in POP chain can be used to execute arbitrary code on the server. Additional built-in gadget chains allow arbitrary local file read in both WP STAGING and WP STAGING Pro and arbitrary file deletion in WP STAGING Pro. The attacker does not require Administrator credentials or a copy of a backup, but exploitation does require the later privileged restore or reset.
vendor_products: renehermi WP STAGING – Backups & Restore, Migration & Clone Plugin – Cloud Backups, Scheduled Backups

items.title: Email Templates Customizer and Designer for WordPress and WooCommerce <= 1.5.14 - Missing Authorization to Unauthenticated Order PII Disclosure via 'preview_order' Parameter
items.description: The Email Templates Customizer and Designer for WordPress and WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 1.5.14 This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. items.title: Node.js is vulnerable to HTTP/2 response memory disclosure via a use-after-free during stream teardown
items.description: A use-after-free in Node.js HTTP/2 stream teardown can leak response memory, including the contents of other connections' response buffers, to a peer. When a stream is torn down while a write is still backpressured, for example by a peer RST_STREAM or by the server's own per-stream timeout destroying the stream, the stream's response buffer is freed but a reference to it is still used, so freed or unrelated heap memory is written to the socket instead of the intended response. On Node.js 26.x and 24.x the teardown can be driven purely by a remote peer once the window-size change from 26.9.0 and 24.22.0 is present, and on all supported lines the same defect is reachable through an application-initiated teardown such as a per-stream idle timeout. This vulnerability affects Node.js 26.x, 24.x, and 22.x.

items.title: dnspython excessive memory and CPU use
items.description: dnspython is a DNS toolkit for Python. Prior to version 2.9.2, the from_text() parser for WKS records does not require the service number to be between 0 and 65535 before using it as a bitmap offset. An attacker-controlled zone file can supply a larger number, causing the service bitmap to grow to an extremely large size through inefficient repeated extension, consuming excessive memory and CPU and potentially terminating the process. Applications are affected only when they parse zone-file text whose record type and rdata are attacker controlled. This issue is fixed in version 2.9.2.

items.title: rtMedia for WordPress, BuddyPress and bbPress <= 4.7.17 - Unauthenticated SQL Injection via 'custom_fields' Parameter
items.description: The rtMedia for WordPress, BuddyPress and bbPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'custom_fields' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.7.17 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database. The upload endpoint's only access control is a nonce check, and the 'rtmedia_upload_nonce' value is localized to every unauthenticated visitor on every front-end page via wp_enqueue_scripts, making it freely obtainable without an account.

items.title: MC4WP: Mailchimp for WordPress < 4.15.0 - Unauthenticated Arbitrary Shortcode Execution via Dynamic Content Tag
items.description: The MC4WP: Mailchimp for WordPress WordPress plugin before 4.15.0 does not prevent request-derived values in its dynamic content tags from being processed as shortcodes when a form is embedded with its block, allowing unauthenticated visitors to execute arbitrary registered shortcodes with attacker-chosen attributes. This requires the site owner to have added a request-derived tag to the form content and to embed the form with the block rather than the classic shortcode.

Timezone cache use-after-free can lead to remote code execution.

In non-thread-safe builds, a diagnostic written to a file-based error_log during module startup, for example for an invalid date.timezone value or a session configuration warning, causes the timezone cache to be allocated in startup memory that is freed while a reference to it is kept. A diagnostic raised early in the first request of a worker, such as the max_input_vars warning, then accesses the freed cache. On such a deployment an unauthenticated remote attacker can crash PHP-FPM, Apache mod_php or CGI workers with a crafted request. Arbitrary code execution may be possible and has been demonstrated with known memory addresses.

This issue affects PHP versions before 8.2.36, 8.3.* before 8.3.37, 8.4.* before 8.4.28 and 8.5.* before 8.5.13.

items.title: FeedWordPress <= 2026.0517 - Unauthenticated Stored Cross-Site Scripting via Syndicated Feed Content
items.description: The FeedWordPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting in versions up to, and including, 2026.0517 via syndicated RSS/Atom feed content. The plugin's SyndicatedPost::sanitize_content() function only strips the 'target' attribute (the lines that would strip 'style' and 'on[a-z]+' event-handler attributes are commented out), and SyndicatedPost::insert_post() deliberately removes WordPress's wp_filter_kses and wp_filter_post_kses filters from content_save_pre before persisting imported feed items via wp_insert_post(). This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers who control an external feed that a site has already subscribed to to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

items.title: Lightbox & Modal Popup WordPress Plugin <= 2.8.7 - Unauthenticated Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via Image Alt Attribute in .wp-caption Containers
items.description: The Lightbox & Modal Popup WordPress Plugin – FooBox plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'img alt attribute inside .wp-caption container' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.8.7 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This is exploitable by Subscriber-level users when bbPress is installed, as its bbp_filter_kses filter chain permits img and pre tags while preserving numeric character references inside attribute values, allowing encoded payloads to bypass save-time sanitization and reach the vulnerable sink fully intact. Exploitation by attackers with subscriber-level access and above requires that bbPress 2.6.20 is installed, a public forum exists, and either the first topic has already been approved or subsequent topics clear moderation. On a default installation, where that is not configured, the vulnerability requires attackers with contributor-level access and above.

Description
When NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source is configured with the ngx_stream_ssl_preread_module module, a specially crafted ClientHello message from an unauthenticated attacker causes forged values of the ngx_stream_ssl_preread_module variables, affecting virtual server selection. In addition, it may also cause a disagreement with a proxied server terminating the SSL/TLS connection without Transport Layer Security (TLS) 1.3 support.

Impact
This vulnerability may allow an attacker to forge values of the ngx_stream_ssl_preread_module variables and bypass the NGINX systems stream routing segmentation. As a result, the attacker may be able to route the connection to a privileged or internal backend that should be unreachable and gain access to sensitive information. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only.






Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

items.title: BIG-IP iRule Vulnerability
items.description:
Description:

When an iRule that processes client traffic using the GENERICMESSAGE::route command is configured on a virtual server, undisclosed requests can cause the Traffic Management Microkernel (TMM) to terminate and may lead to remote code execution (RCE). 





Impact:



Traffic is disrupted while the TMM process restarts. This vulnerability allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) on the BIG-IP system and may allow the attacker to perform RCE. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only.







Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

items.title: Missing origin validation for the externalbrowser authenticator callback in multiple Snowflake client drivers
items.description: Multiple Snowflake client drivers implementing the `authenticator=externalbrowser` single sign-on flow could have allowed an attacker to interfere with a user's login attempt through weaknesses in the local loopback callback listener used to receive the identity provider's response. The listener reflected an arbitrary request's Origin header into its CORS response headers and accepted the first token-bearing request it received during the login window without verifying a CSRF state value bound to that specific login attempt. An attacker able to reach the listener during an active login might have leveraged this to submit a forged callback response, causing the authentication attempt to fail. The fix is available in Snowflake Connector for Python 4.8.0, Snowflake Go Driver v2.3.0, Snowflake JDBC Driver 4.4.0 (including the snowflake-jdbc-fips and snowflake-jdbc-thin artifacts), Snowflake Node.js Driver 3.4.0, Snowflake Connector for .NET 6.3.0, Snowflake ODBC Driver 4.0.0, Snowflake PHP PDO Driver 4.3.0, and libsnowflakeclient 2.11.1. Go v1 users must migrate to the latest major version of the module. Users must manually upgrade.

items.title: BlockArt Blocks <= 2.4.3 - Missing Authorization to Authenticated (Contributor+) Sensitive Information Disclosure via 'queryArgs' and 'query[post_status]' Block Attributes
items.description: The BlockArt Blocks – Gutenberg Blocks, Page Builder Blocks ,WordPress Block Plugin, Sections & Template Library plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 2.4.3. This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to view the title, excerpt, and full content of other users' draft, pending, and private posts, exposing that content to unauthenticated visitors on the published permalink. This is exploitable by an Author-level user because WordPress's wp_filter_post_kses preserves block-comment JSON in HTML comments, allowing the malicious queryArgs and query[post_status] attributes to survive post saving and execute on every unauthenticated request to the published URL. Exploitation by attackers with contributor-level access and above requires that attacker only needs to see the data themselves (not expose it to unauthenticated visitors) — satisfied by viewing their own preview URL. On a default installation, where that is not configured, the vulnerability requires attackers with author-level access and above.
vendor_products: wpblockart BlockArt Blocks – Gutenberg Blocks, Page Builder Blocks ,WordPress Block Plugin, Sections & Template Library

items.title: OpenTelemetry Python: Unbounded memory allocation in Jaeger baggage propagation
items.description: OpenTelemetry Python provides the Python API and SDK for OpenTelemetry. Prior to 1.45.0, JaegerPropagator.extract() in opentelemetry-propagator-jaeger processes inbound uberctx-* baggage values without entry, per-entry byte, or total-byte limits. Services that enable the optional Jaeger propagator can perform unnecessary CPU work and short-lived heap allocations when an untrusted carrier supplies numerous or oversized values, contributing to denial of service when transport-level limits do not constrain the input. Common default Python HTTP server limits reduce the practical impact, while custom getters, non-HTTP transports, or raised header limits increase exposure. This issue is fixed in version 1.45.0.

items.title: Pillow: EPS load(scale) lets Ghostscript render past the decompression bomb limit
items.description: Pillow is a Python imaging library. In versions 2.3.0 through 12.3.0, EPS rendering does not validate the scaled image dimensions before invoking Ghostscript. Applications that process untrusted EPS or PostScript files using an application-selected scale greater than one can incur excessive Ghostscript CPU and temporary disk consumption. In versions with decompression-bomb protection, the scaled output is checked only after Ghostscript has completed rendering, allowing resource consumption beyond the configured pixel limit. The amplification depends on the scale selected by the application, not an attacker-controlled scale value. This issue is fixed in version 13.0.0.

items.title: `http.cookiejar` applies expired `Set-Cookie` to cookie store before policy validation
items.description:
http.cookiejar.CookieJar deleted a stored cookie when a response carried an
already expired Set-Cookie header for it, using the Domain and Path
attributes from the header without consulting the cookie policy. A server
could therefore delete cookies belonging to other domains from a shared
cookie jar, such as the one used by urllib's HTTPCookieProcessor. The fix
consults the cookie policy before an expired cookie may delete an existing
one, as required by RFC 6265 section 5.3.

items.title: Masterstudy - Education WordPress Theme <= 4.8.151 - Missing Authorization to Authenticated (Subscriber+) Privilege Escalation
items.description: The Masterstudy - Education WordPress Theme theme for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including, 4.8.151. This is due to missing authorization and nonce validation on the `masterstudy_ms_stm_set_discard_transient` AJAX action. items.title: Flexible PDF Invoices for WooCommerce & WordPress <= 7.1.2 - Unauthenticated Stored Cross-Site Scripting via Billing Field
items.description: The Flexible PDF Invoices for WooCommerce & WordPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'billing_address.first_name / extensions.wpdesk-flexible-invoices-checkout._billing_vat_number' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.1.2 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Execution requires an administrator to open the invoice edit page for the attacker's order and interact with (e.g., type into or trigger a change/keyup event on) a field in the customer metabox, at which point the payload stored in billing fields such as first_name or _billing_vat_number is decoded from its entity-escaped input value and passed unsanitized to jQuery .html(). Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.
vendor_products: wpdesk Flexible PDF Invoices for WooCommerce & WordPress
